top_queries.sql:
select top 25 COALESCE(fn.id, 0) as id, [p].[id] as [pra_id], [p].[prop_id], COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) as mlsfNo, COALESCE(NULLIF(fn.FileName, ''), p.Grantee) as FileName, [p].[instrument_type] as [pra_instrument_type], [p].[Grantor], [p].[Grantee], [p].[party_1] as [pra_party_1], [p].[party_2] as [pra_party_2], [p].[regNo], [p].[op_type], [p].[op_serial_number], [p].[property_description], [p].[location] as [pra_location], [p].[created_by] as [pra_created_by], [p].[created_at] as [pra_created_at], [p].[commissioned_sort_at], [tot_agg].[latest_tot_created_at] as [tot_created_at], [fn].[SOURCE] as [file_number_source], [fn].[temp_fileno] as [fn_temp_fileno], COALESCE(NULLIF(p.plot_no, ''), fn.plot_no, mfn.plot_no) as plot_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.tp_no, ''), fn.tp_no, mfn.tp_no) as tp_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.lgsaOrCity, ''), fn.lga, mfn.lga) as lga, COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(NULLIF(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.location))), 'OTHER'), 'OTHERS'),
                    p.property_description,
                    NULLIF(NULLIF(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(fn.location))), 'OTHER'), 'OTHERS'),
                    p.location
                ) as location, fi_geo.latitude as fi_latitude, fi_geo.longitude as fi_longitude, [fn].[created_at] as [fn_created_at], [fn].[commissioning_date], [fn].[is_deleted], COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(fn_user.first_name,  ''), ' ', COALESCE(fn_user.last_name,  '')))), ''),
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(fn.created_by AS nvarchar(100)))), ''),
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(mfn.created_by AS nvarchar(100)))), ''),
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(pra_user.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(pra_user.last_name, '')))), ''),
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.created_by)), ''),
                    N'—'
                ) as created_by_name, [mfn].[source] as [mls_source], [mfn].[id] as [mls_file_no_id], COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(mfn.customer_type)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(cs_agg.customer_type)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(fi_agg.resolved_type)), '')) as resolved_customer_type, [mfn].[full_file_number] as [mfn_full_file_number], COALESCE(
                    mfn.land_use,
                    p.land_use,
                    CASE
                        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) LIKE 'RES%' THEN 'RES'
                        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) LIKE 'COM%' THEN 'COM'
                        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) LIKE 'CON%' THEN 'COM'
                        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) LIKE 'IND%' THEN 'IND'
                        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) LIKE 'AGR%' THEN 'AGR'
                        ELSE NULL
                    END
                ) as land_use, [mfn].[sub_source], [mfn].[source_instrument_capture_id], [mfn].[source_pra_id], [mfn].[con_commissioned_at], [mfn].[batch_no], [mfn].[op_batch], [mfn].[serial_number] as [mfn_serial_number], [source_capture].[purpose] as [source_purpose], [source_capture].[land_use] as [source_land_use], [source_capture].[district] as [source_district], [source_capture].[party_1_phone] as [source_party_1_phone], [source_capture].[party_1_address] as [source_party_1_address], [source_capture].[party_2_phone] as [source_party_2_phone], [source_capture].[party_2_address] as [source_party_2_address], COALESCE(source_capture.party_1_name, p.Grantor, p.party_1) as source_party_1_name_fallback, COALESCE(source_capture.party_2_name, p.Grantee, p.party_2) as source_party_2_name_fallback, COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(p.temp_fileno, ''),
                    tf_agg.earliest_temp_fileno,
                    fn.temp_fileno
                ) as source_temp_fileno from (
                SELECT id, prop_id, parent_prop_id, mlsFNo, fileno, temp_fileno, instrument_type,
                       Grantor, Grantee, party_1, party_2, regNo, op_type,
                       op_serial_number, property_description, location,
                       created_by, created_at, plot_no, tp_no, lgsaOrCity,
                       land_use, system_source,
                       -- The listing is ordered by when the file was commissioned.
                       -- This branch's created_at already is that moment (the Transfer
                       -- of Title row is written as the file is commissioned), so it
                       -- needs no separate key. The link branches below do — see there.
                       CAST(NULL AS datetime2) as commissioned_sort_at,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(parent_prop_id, ''), prop_id), instrument_type ORDER BY id DESC) as rn
                FROM pra
                WHERE system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                  AND prop_id IS NOT NULL AND prop_id != ''
                  AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
                  AND (instrument_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%' OR transaction_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')

                UNION ALL

                -- pra.prop_id is NVARCHAR whereas instrument_capture.prop_id is BIGINT.
                -- The explicit cast keeps UNION from coercing PRA values (which include
                -- non-numeric property IDs) to BIGINT, even when this branch is disabled.
                SELECT ic.id, CAST(ic.prop_id AS nvarchar(100)) as prop_id, NULL as parent_prop_id, ic.mlsFNo, NULL as fileno, ic.temp_fileno,
                       ic.instrument_type,
                       'Kano State Government' as Grantor, ic.party_1_name as Grantee,
                       'Kano State Government' as party_1, ic.party_1_name as party_2,
                       ic.registration_number as regNo, ic.op_type,
                       ic.op_serial_number, ic.property_description, ic.property_location as location,
                       CAST(ic.created_by AS nvarchar(100)) as created_by, ic.created_at,
                       ic.plot_number as plot_no, ic.tp_no, ic.lga as lgsaOrCity,
                       ic.land_use, 'IC_SOURCE' as system_source,
                       CAST(NULL AS datetime2) as commissioned_sort_at,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.prop_id, ic.instrument_type ORDER BY ic.id DESC) as rn
                FROM instrument_capture ic
                LEFT JOIN pra px ON px.prop_id = CAST(ic.prop_id AS nvarchar(100))
                                AND px.system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                                -- Only treat OP-type PRA rows as IC duplicates.
                                -- A ToT row sharing the same prop_id (legacy
                                -- pre-lineage data) does NOT mean the OP is
                                -- already represented in PRA \u2014 the OP still
                                -- lives only in instrument_capture and must be
                                -- surfaced from this branch.
                                AND (px.instrument_type IS NULL
                                     OR px.instrument_type NOT LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')
                                AND (px.transaction_type IS NULL
                                     OR px.transaction_type NOT LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')
                WHERE ic.instrument_type = 'Occupancy Permit (OP)'
                  AND ic.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND ic.prop_id != 0
                  AND (ic.is_deleted IS NULL OR ic.is_deleted = '0')
                  AND px.id IS NULL
                  AND '0' = '1'

                UNION ALL

                -- IC source rows can predate their mlsFNo stamp. For Change of
                -- Ownership, the commissioning link is the authoritative file number.
                SELECT linked_ic.id, CAST(linked_ic.prop_id AS nvarchar(100)) as prop_id,
                       NULL as parent_prop_id, linked_mfn.full_file_number as mlsFNo,
                       NULL as fileno, linked_ic.temp_fileno, linked_ic.instrument_type,
                       'Kano State Government' as Grantor, linked_ic.party_1_name as Grantee,
                       'Kano State Government' as party_1, linked_ic.party_1_name as party_2,
                       linked_ic.registration_number as regNo, linked_ic.op_type,
                       linked_ic.op_serial_number, linked_ic.property_description,
                       linked_ic.property_location as location,
                       CAST(linked_ic.created_by AS nvarchar(100)) as created_by, linked_ic.created_at,
                       -- Property details corrected at commissioning live on the file
                       -- record; the source OP keeps its original (often blank or
                       -- superseded) values. Prefer the file, fall back to the OP.
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.plot_no, ''), linked_ic.plot_number) as plot_no,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.tp_no, ''), linked_ic.tp_no) as tp_no,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.lga, ''), linked_ic.lga) as lgsaOrCity,
                       linked_ic.land_use, 'IC_SOURCE_LINK' as system_source,
                       -- This row describes a commissioned file, but every other column
                       -- here comes from the *source OP*, which was captured long before
                       -- the file was commissioned. Carry the file's own timestamp so the
                       -- listing can order (and date) by when it was actually commissioned
                       -- rather than by when the OP was first captured.
                       linked_mfn.created_at as commissioned_sort_at,
                       -- A source OP can be commissioned into more than one file. Keep
                       -- every commissioned file, rather than arbitrarily retaining one
                       -- row for the shared property/OP.
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY linked_mfn.full_file_number ORDER BY linked_ic.id DESC) as rn
                FROM mls_file_no linked_mfn
                INNER JOIN instrument_capture linked_ic
                        ON linked_ic.id = linked_mfn.source_instrument_capture_id
                WHERE '1' = '1'
                  AND linked_mfn.system_sub_type = 'OSS'
                  AND linked_mfn.sub_source = 'OP Change of Ownership'
                  AND linked_ic.instrument_type = 'Occupancy Permit (OP)'
                  AND linked_ic.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND linked_ic.prop_id != 0
                  AND (linked_ic.is_deleted IS NULL OR linked_ic.is_deleted = '0')
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM pra dup_pra
                      WHERE dup_pra.system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                        AND dup_pra.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND dup_pra.prop_id != ''
                        AND (dup_pra.is_deleted IS NULL OR dup_pra.is_deleted = 0)
                        AND (dup_pra.instrument_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%'
                             OR dup_pra.transaction_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')
                        AND COALESCE(NULLIF(dup_pra.mlsFNo, ''), dup_pra.fileno) = linked_mfn.full_file_number
                  )

                UNION ALL

                -- A few early Change-of-Ownership commissions point at their originating
                -- PRA OP, but that OP predates the OSS system_source stamp and carries only
                -- a TEMP number. Use the commissioned file linked by source_pra_id instead.
                SELECT linked_pra.id, linked_pra.prop_id, linked_pra.parent_prop_id,
                       linked_mfn.full_file_number as mlsFNo, NULL as fileno, linked_pra.temp_fileno,
                       linked_pra.instrument_type,
                       linked_pra.Grantor, linked_pra.Grantee, linked_pra.party_1, linked_pra.party_2,
                       linked_pra.regNo, linked_pra.op_type, linked_pra.op_serial_number,
                       linked_pra.property_description, linked_pra.location, linked_pra.created_by,
                       linked_pra.created_at,
                       -- See the IC_SOURCE_LINK branch: the file's details win.
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.plot_no, ''), linked_pra.plot_no) as plot_no,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.tp_no, ''), linked_pra.tp_no) as tp_no,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.lga, ''), linked_pra.lgsaOrCity) as lgsaOrCity,
                       linked_pra.land_use, 'PRA_SOURCE_LINK' as system_source,
                       -- See the IC_SOURCE_LINK branch: the file's own timestamp, not the
                       -- source OP's capture date.
                       linked_mfn.created_at as commissioned_sort_at,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY linked_mfn.full_file_number ORDER BY linked_pra.id DESC) as rn
                FROM pra linked_pra
                INNER JOIN mls_file_no linked_mfn ON linked_mfn.source_pra_id = linked_pra.id
                WHERE '1' = '1'
                  AND linked_mfn.system_sub_type = 'OSS'
                  AND linked_mfn.sub_source = 'OP Change of Ownership'
                  AND linked_pra.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND linked_pra.prop_id != ''
                  AND (linked_pra.is_deleted IS NULL OR linked_pra.is_deleted = 0)
                  AND (linked_pra.system_source IS NULL OR linked_pra.system_source != 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME')
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM pra dup_pra
                      WHERE dup_pra.system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                        AND dup_pra.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND dup_pra.prop_id != ''
                        AND (dup_pra.is_deleted IS NULL OR dup_pra.is_deleted = 0)
                        AND (dup_pra.instrument_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%'
                             OR dup_pra.transaction_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')
                        AND COALESCE(NULLIF(dup_pra.mlsFNo, ''), dup_pra.fileno) = linked_mfn.full_file_number
                  )
                  -- A file can carry both link columns. The IC_SOURCE_LINK branch above
                  -- already covers those, so skip them here rather than emit a twin row.
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM instrument_capture dup_ic
                      WHERE dup_ic.id = linked_mfn.source_instrument_capture_id
                        AND dup_ic.instrument_type = 'Occupancy Permit (OP)'
                        AND dup_ic.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND dup_ic.prop_id != 0
                        AND (dup_ic.is_deleted IS NULL OR dup_ic.is_deleted = '0')
                  )
        ) as p left join (
                SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mlsfNo ORDER BY id DESC) as fn_rn
                FROM fileNumber
            ) as fn on fn.mlsfNo = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) and [fn].[fn_rn] = ? left join [mls_file_no] as [mfn] on mfn.full_file_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) and mfn.id = (
                         SELECT MAX(x.id) FROM mls_file_no x
                         WHERE x.full_file_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno)
                     ) left join (
                SELECT
                    COALESCE(NULLIF(p1.parent_prop_id, ''), p1.prop_id) as op_prop_id,
                    MAX(p1.created_at) as latest_tot_created_at
                FROM pra p1
                WHERE p1.system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                  AND (p1.is_deleted IS NULL OR p1.is_deleted = 0)
                  AND (
                      p1.instrument_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%'
                      OR p1.transaction_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%'
                  )
                GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p1.parent_prop_id, ''), p1.prop_id)
            ) as tot_agg on [tot_agg].[op_prop_id] = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.parent_prop_id, ''), p.prop_id) left join [instrument_capture] as [source_capture] on [source_capture].[id] = [mfn].[source_instrument_capture_id] left join [users] as [pra_user] on TRY_CAST(p.created_by AS INT) = [pra_user].[id] left join [users] as [fn_user] on TRY_CAST(fn.created_by AS INT) = [fn_user].[id] left join (
                SELECT p2_inner.prop_id, MIN(p2_inner.temp_fileno) as earliest_temp_fileno
                FROM pra p2_inner
                WHERE p2_inner.system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                  AND (p2_inner.is_deleted IS NULL OR p2_inner.is_deleted = 0)
                  AND p2_inner.temp_fileno IS NOT NULL AND p2_inner.temp_fileno != ''
                  AND (p2_inner.instrument_type IS NULL OR p2_inner.instrument_type NOT LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')
                GROUP BY p2_inner.prop_id
            ) as tf_agg on [tf_agg].[prop_id] = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.parent_prop_id, ''), p.prop_id) left join (
                    SELECT file_number, MAX(customer_type) as customer_type
                    FROM customers_staging
                    GROUP BY file_number
                ) as cs_agg on cs_agg.file_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) left join (
                    SELECT file_number, MAX(file_type) as resolved_type
                    FROM file_indexings
                    GROUP BY file_number
                ) as fi_agg on fi_agg.file_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) left join (
                    SELECT file_number,
                           MAX(latitude) as latitude,
                           MAX(longitude) as longitude
                    FROM file_indexings
                    WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY file_number
                ) as fi_geo on fi_geo.file_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) where [p].[rn] = ? and ([fn].[is_deleted] is null or [fn].[is_deleted] = ?) and exists (select 1 from [mls_file_no] as [mfn_flt] where mfn_flt.full_file_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) and [mfn_flt].[full_file_number] is not null) order by COALESCE(mfn.con_commissioned_at, p.commissioned_sort_at, p.created_at) DESC

select top 1 
                COUNT(DISTINCT stats_source.prop_id) as total_count,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(stats_source.land_use, '')))) LIKE '%RES%' THEN stats_source.prop_id END) as res_count,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(stats_source.land_use, '')))) LIKE '%COM%' THEN stats_source.prop_id END) as com_count,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(stats_source.land_use, '')))) LIKE '%IND%' THEN stats_source.prop_id END) as ind_count,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(stats_source.land_use, '')))) LIKE '%AGR%' THEN stats_source.prop_id END) as agr_count,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(stats_source.land_use, '')))) NOT LIKE '%RES%'
                                     AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(stats_source.land_use, '')))) NOT LIKE '%COM%'
                                     AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(stats_source.land_use, '')))) NOT LIKE '%IND%'
                                     AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(stats_source.land_use, '')))) NOT LIKE '%AGR%'
                                    THEN stats_source.prop_id END) as unclassified_count
             from (
                SELECT raw_stats.prop_id,
                       COALESCE(
                           NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(raw_stats.land_use)), ''),
                           NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(mfn_lu.land_use)), ''),
                           NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(sib_lu.land_use)), ''),
                           CASE
                              WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_stats.mlsFNo, ''), raw_stats.fileno) LIKE 'RES-%' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
                              WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_stats.mlsFNo, ''), raw_stats.fileno) LIKE 'COM-%' THEN 'COMMERCIAL'
                              WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_stats.mlsFNo, ''), raw_stats.fileno) LIKE 'IND-%' THEN 'INDUSTRIAL'
                              WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_stats.mlsFNo, ''), raw_stats.fileno) LIKE 'AGR-%' THEN 'AGRICULTURAL'
                          END
                       ) as land_use,
                       raw_stats.mlsFNo,
                       raw_stats.fileno
                FROM (
                    SELECT prop_id, land_use, mlsFNo, fileno
                    FROM pra
                    WHERE system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                      AND prop_id IS NOT NULL AND prop_id != ''
                      AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
                      AND (instrument_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%' OR transaction_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')

                    
                ) as raw_stats
                LEFT JOIN mls_file_no as mfn_lu
                       ON mfn_lu.full_file_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(raw_stats.mlsFNo, ''), raw_stats.fileno)
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT CAST(prop_id AS nvarchar(100)) as prop_id, MAX(land_use) as land_use
                    FROM pra
                    WHERE prop_id IS NOT NULL AND prop_id != ''
                      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(land_use, ''))) != ''
                      AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
                    GROUP BY CAST(prop_id AS nvarchar(100))
                ) as sib_lu
                       ON sib_lu.prop_id = CAST(raw_stats.prop_id AS nvarchar(100))
            ) as stats_source inner join [mls_file_no] as [mfn_stat] on mfn_stat.full_file_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(stats_source.mlsFNo, ''), stats_source.fileno) and [mfn_stat].[full_file_number] is not null
select * from [allocation_list_stage] where [is_allocated] = ? order by [first_name] asc

select count(*) as aggregate from (
                SELECT id, prop_id, parent_prop_id, mlsFNo, fileno, temp_fileno, instrument_type,
                       Grantor, Grantee, party_1, party_2, regNo, op_type,
                       op_serial_number, property_description, location,
                       created_by, created_at, plot_no, tp_no, lgsaOrCity,
                       land_use, system_source,
                       -- The listing is ordered by when the file was commissioned.
                       -- This branch's created_at already is that moment (the Transfer
                       -- of Title row is written as the file is commissioned), so it
                       -- needs no separate key. The link branches below do — see there.
                       CAST(NULL AS datetime2) as commissioned_sort_at,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(parent_prop_id, ''), prop_id), instrument_type ORDER BY id DESC) as rn
                FROM pra
                WHERE system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                  AND prop_id IS NOT NULL AND prop_id != ''
                  AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
                  AND (instrument_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%' OR transaction_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')

                UNION ALL

                -- pra.prop_id is NVARCHAR whereas instrument_capture.prop_id is BIGINT.
                -- The explicit cast keeps UNION from coercing PRA values (which include
                -- non-numeric property IDs) to BIGINT, even when this branch is disabled.
                SELECT ic.id, CAST(ic.prop_id AS nvarchar(100)) as prop_id, NULL as parent_prop_id, ic.mlsFNo, NULL as fileno, ic.temp_fileno,
                       ic.instrument_type,
                       'Kano State Government' as Grantor, ic.party_1_name as Grantee,
                       'Kano State Government' as party_1, ic.party_1_name as party_2,
                       ic.registration_number as regNo, ic.op_type,
                       ic.op_serial_number, ic.property_description, ic.property_location as location,
                       CAST(ic.created_by AS nvarchar(100)) as created_by, ic.created_at,
                       ic.plot_number as plot_no, ic.tp_no, ic.lga as lgsaOrCity,
                       ic.land_use, 'IC_SOURCE' as system_source,
                       CAST(NULL AS datetime2) as commissioned_sort_at,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.prop_id, ic.instrument_type ORDER BY ic.id DESC) as rn
                FROM instrument_capture ic
                LEFT JOIN pra px ON px.prop_id = CAST(ic.prop_id AS nvarchar(100))
                                AND px.system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                                -- Only treat OP-type PRA rows as IC duplicates.
                                -- A ToT row sharing the same prop_id (legacy
                                -- pre-lineage data) does NOT mean the OP is
                                -- already represented in PRA \u2014 the OP still
                                -- lives only in instrument_capture and must be
                                -- surfaced from this branch.
                                AND (px.instrument_type IS NULL
                                     OR px.instrument_type NOT LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')
                                AND (px.transaction_type IS NULL
                                     OR px.transaction_type NOT LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')
                WHERE ic.instrument_type = 'Occupancy Permit (OP)'
                  AND ic.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND ic.prop_id != 0
                  AND (ic.is_deleted IS NULL OR ic.is_deleted = '0')
                  AND px.id IS NULL
                  AND '0' = '1'

                UNION ALL

                -- IC source rows can predate their mlsFNo stamp. For Change of
                -- Ownership, the commissioning link is the authoritative file number.
                SELECT linked_ic.id, CAST(linked_ic.prop_id AS nvarchar(100)) as prop_id,
                       NULL as parent_prop_id, linked_mfn.full_file_number as mlsFNo,
                       NULL as fileno, linked_ic.temp_fileno, linked_ic.instrument_type,
                       'Kano State Government' as Grantor, linked_ic.party_1_name as Grantee,
                       'Kano State Government' as party_1, linked_ic.party_1_name as party_2,
                       linked_ic.registration_number as regNo, linked_ic.op_type,
                       linked_ic.op_serial_number, linked_ic.property_description,
                       linked_ic.property_location as location,
                       CAST(linked_ic.created_by AS nvarchar(100)) as created_by, linked_ic.created_at,
                       -- Property details corrected at commissioning live on the file
                       -- record; the source OP keeps its original (often blank or
                       -- superseded) values. Prefer the file, fall back to the OP.
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.plot_no, ''), linked_ic.plot_number) as plot_no,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.tp_no, ''), linked_ic.tp_no) as tp_no,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.lga, ''), linked_ic.lga) as lgsaOrCity,
                       linked_ic.land_use, 'IC_SOURCE_LINK' as system_source,
                       -- This row describes a commissioned file, but every other column
                       -- here comes from the *source OP*, which was captured long before
                       -- the file was commissioned. Carry the file's own timestamp so the
                       -- listing can order (and date) by when it was actually commissioned
                       -- rather than by when the OP was first captured.
                       linked_mfn.created_at as commissioned_sort_at,
                       -- A source OP can be commissioned into more than one file. Keep
                       -- every commissioned file, rather than arbitrarily retaining one
                       -- row for the shared property/OP.
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY linked_mfn.full_file_number ORDER BY linked_ic.id DESC) as rn
                FROM mls_file_no linked_mfn
                INNER JOIN instrument_capture linked_ic
                        ON linked_ic.id = linked_mfn.source_instrument_capture_id
                WHERE '1' = '1'
                  AND linked_mfn.system_sub_type = 'OSS'
                  AND linked_mfn.sub_source = 'OP Change of Ownership'
                  AND linked_ic.instrument_type = 'Occupancy Permit (OP)'
                  AND linked_ic.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND linked_ic.prop_id != 0
                  AND (linked_ic.is_deleted IS NULL OR linked_ic.is_deleted = '0')
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM pra dup_pra
                      WHERE dup_pra.system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                        AND dup_pra.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND dup_pra.prop_id != ''
                        AND (dup_pra.is_deleted IS NULL OR dup_pra.is_deleted = 0)
                        AND (dup_pra.instrument_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%'
                             OR dup_pra.transaction_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')
                        AND COALESCE(NULLIF(dup_pra.mlsFNo, ''), dup_pra.fileno) = linked_mfn.full_file_number
                  )

                UNION ALL

                -- A few early Change-of-Ownership commissions point at their originating
                -- PRA OP, but that OP predates the OSS system_source stamp and carries only
                -- a TEMP number. Use the commissioned file linked by source_pra_id instead.
                SELECT linked_pra.id, linked_pra.prop_id, linked_pra.parent_prop_id,
                       linked_mfn.full_file_number as mlsFNo, NULL as fileno, linked_pra.temp_fileno,
                       linked_pra.instrument_type,
                       linked_pra.Grantor, linked_pra.Grantee, linked_pra.party_1, linked_pra.party_2,
                       linked_pra.regNo, linked_pra.op_type, linked_pra.op_serial_number,
                       linked_pra.property_description, linked_pra.location, linked_pra.created_by,
                       linked_pra.created_at,
                       -- See the IC_SOURCE_LINK branch: the file's details win.
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.plot_no, ''), linked_pra.plot_no) as plot_no,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.tp_no, ''), linked_pra.tp_no) as tp_no,
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(linked_mfn.lga, ''), linked_pra.lgsaOrCity) as lgsaOrCity,
                       linked_pra.land_use, 'PRA_SOURCE_LINK' as system_source,
                       -- See the IC_SOURCE_LINK branch: the file's own timestamp, not the
                       -- source OP's capture date.
                       linked_mfn.created_at as commissioned_sort_at,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY linked_mfn.full_file_number ORDER BY linked_pra.id DESC) as rn
                FROM pra linked_pra
                INNER JOIN mls_file_no linked_mfn ON linked_mfn.source_pra_id = linked_pra.id
                WHERE '1' = '1'
                  AND linked_mfn.system_sub_type = 'OSS'
                  AND linked_mfn.sub_source = 'OP Change of Ownership'
                  AND linked_pra.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND linked_pra.prop_id != ''
                  AND (linked_pra.is_deleted IS NULL OR linked_pra.is_deleted = 0)
                  AND (linked_pra.system_source IS NULL OR linked_pra.system_source != 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME')
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM pra dup_pra
                      WHERE dup_pra.system_source = 'OSSOPCHANGEOFNAME'
                        AND dup_pra.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND dup_pra.prop_id != ''
                        AND (dup_pra.is_deleted IS NULL OR dup_pra.is_deleted = 0)
                        AND (dup_pra.instrument_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%'
                             OR dup_pra.transaction_type LIKE '%Transfer of Title%')
                        AND COALESCE(NULLIF(dup_pra.mlsFNo, ''), dup_pra.fileno) = linked_mfn.full_file_number
                  )
                  -- A file can carry both link columns. The IC_SOURCE_LINK branch above
                  -- already covers those, so skip them here rather than emit a twin row.
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM instrument_capture dup_ic
                      WHERE dup_ic.id = linked_mfn.source_instrument_capture_id
                        AND dup_ic.instrument_type = 'Occupancy Permit (OP)'
                        AND dup_ic.prop_id IS NOT NULL AND dup_ic.prop_id != 0
                        AND (dup_ic.is_deleted IS NULL OR dup_ic.is_deleted = '0')
                  )
        ) as p where [p].[rn] = ? and exists (select 1 from [mls_file_no] as [mfn_c] where mfn_c.full_file_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) and [mfn_c].[full_file_number] is not null)

select count(distinct [p].[prop_id]) as aggregate from [pra] as [p] left join [mls_file_no] as [mfn] on mfn.full_file_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(p.mlsFNo, ''), p.fileno) where [p].[system_source] = ? and [p].[prop_id] is not null and [p].[prop_id] != ? and ([p].[is_deleted] is null or [p].[is_deleted] = ?) and CAST(COALESCE(mfn.con_commissioned_at, p.created_at) AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) and [mfn].[full_file_number] is not null
select * from [districts] where [is_active] = ? order by [name] asc

select [file_no], [passport_photo] from [oss_applications] where [file_no] in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) and [passport_photo] is not null and [passport_photo] <> ? and ([is_deleted] is null or [is_deleted] = ?) order by [id] asc
select count(*) as aggregate from [oss_applications] where ([is_deleted] is null or [is_deleted] = ?)
